P.text: The FastAccessVault.rebalanceFunds() function has no access control modifier, allowing anyone to trigger vault rebalancing at will; it also lacks a nonReentrant modifier and makes an external call to the custodian address (which could be a contract) at line 176 via _vaultToken.transfer(custodian, excess).
P.evidence_quote: The `FastAccessVault.rebalanceFunds()` function has no access control modifier, allowing anyone to trigger vault rebalancing at will.

I.text: rebalanceFunds() should be restricted by access control and protected against reentrancy, since it performs an external transfer to the custodian.

V.text: Anyone can call rebalanceFunds() unlimited times, enabling griefing/spam, gas-exhaustion DoS, race conditions with processTransfer() redemptions leaving the vault temporarily under-collateralized, and reentrancy if the custodian is a malicious contract (potentially draining excess twice with ERC777 or callback-enabled tokens).
V.evidence_quote: Malicious custodian contract can re-enter during transfer
